newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech unit gets Hong Kong order.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech unit gets Hong Kong order.

text.p: Austrian Energy, a subsidiary of VA Technologie AG, on Friday said it had received an order worth 300 million schillings for the construction of two fluidised bed boilers plants.
The order came from Norscan Tech Ltd Hong Kong, a subsidiary of U.S.-based Asia Pacific Resource International Holding Ltd, and the plants will be situated in Changsu, 100 km from Shanghai.
Delivery of the plants is scheduled for early 1998.
Austrian Energy is Austria's market leader in thermal energy production and environmental technology.
